lines: // Werkbank: Hell/Dunkel aus dem Launcher (vor gespeicherter Einstellung und System).

if let Some(dark) = (std::env::var("WERKBANK_THEME").ok().or_else(|| { let base = if cfg!(windows) { std::path::PathBuf::from(std::env::var_os("LOCALAPPDATA")?).join("Werkbank").join("config") } else if cfg!(target_os = "macos") { std::path::PathBuf::from(std::env::var_os("HOME")?).join("Library/Application Support/Werkbank") } else { std::env::var_os("XDG_CONFIG_HOME").map(std::path::PathBuf::from).filter(|p| p.is_absolute()).or_else(|| std::env::var_os("HOME").map(|h| std::path::PathBuf::from(h).join(".config")))?.join("werkbank") }; std::fs::read_to_string(base.join("thema.txt")).ok() }).and_then(|v| match v.trim().to_ascii_lowercase().as_str() { "dunkel" | "dark" => Some(true), "hell" | "light" => Some(false), _ => None })) { app.set_theme_preference(if dark { pdfcraft_ui_egui::theme::ThemePreference::Dark } else { pdfcraft_ui_egui::theme::ThemePreference::Light }); }
